players.name: Raleigh/Jeffers
players.summary: Ryan Jeffers placed on 10-day IL on May 21 with a fractured left hamate (suffered May 19 vs. Houston). Surgery required; expected to miss 6-8 weeks. Victor Caratini takes over as primary catcher.

sources.title: Ryan Jeffers Diagnosed With Hamate Fracture

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: Harper and the Phillies had an off day Thursday ahead of their Cleveland series. Harper is slashing .274/.365/.536 with 5 HR in 2026.

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: Giants had an off day Thursday. Arraez (.302 AVG) continues to be the team's offensive anchor amid a rough Giants season, generating All-Star buzz.

sources.title: Amid an ugly season, the Giants still have a bright spot: All-Star candidate Luis Arráez

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: Bichette went 1-for-4 with a 2-RBI single Thursday as the Mets earned a series split in Washington 2-1. He hit .389 (7-for-18) with 3 HR and 9 RBI in the 4-game series.

sources.title: Bichette drives in two runs, Mets earn series split with win over Nationals

players.name: Lindor/McGonigle
players.summary: McGonigle went hitless (walked once) as the Tigers were swept in four games by the division-leading Guardians. He is batting .176 on the season.

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: PCA went 0-for-4 in a 5-0 loss to Milwaukee, completing a 3-game sweep. He finished the series 1-for-11 with 6 K and two errors, drawing scrutiny from manager Craig Counsell.

sources.title: Brewers 5, Cubs 0: Pete Crow-Armstrong and the Cubs look utterly lost

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: Merrill left Wednesday's game vs. LAD with an apparent back injury sustained leaping for Shohei Ohtani's leadoff homer in the 1st inning. The Padres had an off day Thursday; imaging results pending.

sources.title: Padres' Jackson Merrill Exits Game vs Dodgers With Apparent Injury in Concerning Development

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: Hernández snapped a 23-game homerless drought with a 3-run blast off Corbin Burnes in the 6th inning, accounting for all Dodger runs in a 3-1 win over Arizona. The 413-foot shot to dead center also ended Burnes' 21-consecutive-scoreless-inning streak.

players.name: Stanton/Rice
players.summary: Ben Rice went 0-for-4 Thursday as the Yankees were shut out 2-0 by Toronto's bullpen in the series finale. Despite the off night, Rice leads the Yankees in batting and has 16 HR on the season.

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: Williams earned save #7 Thursday, working a scoreless 9th (1 H, 1 K) to preserve the Mets' 2-1 win at Washington. He let a potential tying run reach 2nd on a Daylen Lile double but held on.

sources.title: Mets' Devin Williams: Hangs on for seventh save

players.name: Zack Wheeler
players.summary: Phillies had an off day Thursday; Wheeler (3-0, 1.99 ERA) starts Friday vs. Cleveland. He has been dominant since returning from thoracic outlet syndrome surgery.

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: Ragans is on the 15-day IL (left elbow impingement, retroactive to May 7). He threw a 30-pitch bullpen session on May 18 and is on track to return around May 22. The Royals are optimistic about a minimal IL stint.

sources.title: Royals Receive Encouraging Update on Cole Ragans' Injury Status

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Reds had an off day Thursday. Burns (6-1, 1.83 ERA) was excellent in his last start May 19 vs. PHI: 6 IP, 9 K, 1 ER, W. He leads the NL in strikeouts.

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Rangers had an off day Thursday ahead of a series vs. the Angels. Eovaldi bounced back from a May 11 scratch (left side tightness) with 7 scoreless innings vs. Houston on May 17.

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: Dustin May (not Sheehan) started Thursday for the Dodgers in a 3-1 win over Arizona. Sheehan (3-1, 4.54 ERA in 9 starts) last pitched May 19 vs. SD; next projected start ~May 24-25.

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: Jose Soriano started for the Angels Thursday in a 3-2 loss to Oakland. Detmers (1-5, 5.37 ERA in 11 starts) remains in the LAA rotation and is projected next in line.

injuries.name: Raleigh/Jeffers
injuries.note: Surgery required; expected return mid-July (6-8 weeks). Fractured hamate suffered May 19 vs. Houston during foul ball in 8th inning.

source.title: Ryan Jeffers Diagnosed With Hamate Fracture

injuries.name: Jackson Merrill
injuries.note: Left May 20 game vs. LAD with apparent back injury sustained leaping for Ohtani's first-pitch homer. Awaiting imaging to determine IL status.

source.title: Padres' Jackson Merrill Exits Game vs Dodgers With Apparent Injury

injuries.name: Cole Ragans
injuries.note: On IL since May 7 with valgus extension overload (pitcher's elbow). Threw 30-pitch bullpen May 18; expected back ~May 22.

source.title: Royals Receive Encouraging Update on Cole Ragans' Injury Status
